name: Docs And Ontology Pack Reuse Refactor
description:
This PRD refactors the recently added docs lifecycle and ontology pack authoring features to improve reuse, maintainability, and future extension safety without changing behavior. The current implementation works and passes tests, but core command files and generator modules have grown large: `packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts` owns status, collect, PRD context, follow-up parsing, completed record detection, role coverage, printing, and command dispatch; `packages/cli/src/commands/ontology.ts` owns prompt extraction, artifact registry, pack scaffold, pack validate, and activation dispatch; `ontology-pack-scaffold-plan.ts` combines plan derivation, CLI parsing, diagnostics, path policy, docs rendering, TypeScript rendering, and test rendering.

The refactor will split reusable domain logic into smaller internal CLI libraries while preserving the current command behavior. It should apply the architecture-neutral identity/data/system separation principle where useful: identity/read-model data lives in small data-oriented modules, and transformation/system logic lives in explicit parser, renderer, readiness, or command-handler modules. This is not a feature PRD and should not change external behavior except for equivalent command help/import paths if needed.

Docs lifecycle extraction and ontology pack extraction should remain reviewable as separate commit groups where practical.

userStories.title: Define Refactor Boundaries And No-Behavior-Change Contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the refactor boundaries documented before moving code so that agents preserve behavior while improving structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Document the refactor boundary in a PRD note or implementation note.
Identify modules to extract from `docs.ts`: TODO lifecycle parser, completed records, follow-up ranking, role matrix, family-only scope usage, and status read-model assembly.
Identify modules to extract from `ontology.ts`: pack scaffold command handler and pack validate command handler.
Identify modules to split from `ontology-pack-scaffold-plan.ts`: plan, paths, diagnostics, docs renderers, code renderers, test renderers, known-pack candidate.
Identify modules to split from `ontology-pack-validate.ts`: loader, runtime validation, file readiness, docs/source-map readiness, summary.
State that JSON shape must remain backward-compatible; object field order is not a compatibility requirement.
State that text output should preserve important wording and command meaning, but exact line ordering is not a compatibility requirement.
State that docs lifecycle extraction and ontology pack extraction should be reviewable as separate commit groups where practical.
Do not move code in this story.
`pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/cli test -- docs` - docs control-plane and CLI regression tests
`pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/cli test -- ontology` - ontology CLI and pack authoring regression tests
`pnpm --filter operational-ontology test -- pack` - operational ontology pack validation regression
`node packages/cli/dist/index.js def validate` - definition graph and source-map validation
userStories.notes: US-001 boundary and no-behavior-change contract recorded in tasks/prd-docs-ontology-pack-reuse-refactor.md under `US-001 Implementation Note: Refactor Boundary And Compatibility Contract`. It identifies docs lifecycle, ontology command, scaffold planning, and pack validation extraction modules; freezes JSON/text compatibility expectations; keeps docs lifecycle and ontology pack extraction reviewable as separate commit groups; and moves no code. Required US-001 gates passed.
